items.title: 3 Cash Flow Stocks Trading Up To 50% Below Fair Value
items.summary: Former IMF economist Gita Gopinath warns that interest rates may stay higher for longer as inflation persists, which keeps pressure on businesses that rely heavily on borrowed money. Cash rich operators with shares priced below the value of their future cash generation look especially interesting in that context. This article walks through three such stocks flagged by a discounted cash flow screen that focuses on mispriced cash flow potential. The three stocks below are only a small sample...
